notes.title: THIS IS THE "PERFORMANCE" UPDATE
notes.content:
The game no longer requires Vulkan. So lower end pcs even MOBILE (coming very soon) is now possible to play it. 
I also optimized performance in several other ways. ENJOY.

notes.title: Biggest Update?
notes.content:
So much changed, 
New hitboxes making it impossible to hit enemies from other floors preventing accidental deaths, new abilities, new playable characters. Bug fixes. I'd start over at the tutorial. Things have come a long way. Tell me what you think!

notes.title: ADDED GRAPPLING HOOK AND YOU CAN SPAWN FART PLATFORMS!
notes.content: Added a grappling hook points to a lot of levels, where you can grapple from. Also added where you can spawn a fart if you tap "run button" in the air. You can grapple on to this fart, or stand on top of it to cross things or save you from falling.

notes.title: GORE UPDATE & SOME ENEMIES HAVE DEATH LINES NOW
ADDED TRAIL EFFECTS, AND REMINDER THERE IS A RUN BUTTON!
notes.content: ADDED TRAIL EFFECTS, AND REMINDER THERE IS A RUN BUTTON!
